name: hermes-otel-dashboard
description: Frontend for the hermes-otel dashboard tab. Dev-time build only: `npm run build` writes ../hermes_otel/dashboard/dist/index.js (committed; the install artifact ships only dist/). CI rebuilds and fails if dist/ is stale, then runs `npm run check` (tsc, eslint, prettier) and `npm test` (vitest: pure helpers plus a rendered smoke test per page).

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check
